baseline_revisions.why: C-4b fix. Before the fix updateInlineHints overwrote #hoa with '0' AFTER gatherInputs had already read $250, so the render was computed from an economic assumption the DOM no longer held: the FHA card showed $3,398/mo PITI and the Gap Solver proposed an $11,783 seller concession to close a $198/mo gap that did not exist. After the fix the N/A checkbox is the economic statement, the typed value survives, and the render agrees with the engine at $3,148/mo — already under target, no gap. The new values were re-derived by tests/oracle/reference_model.py with 0 discrepancies; they were not copied from the app to make the suite pass.

baseline_revisions.why: Gate B.5 Stage 6. The oracle now derives horizon costs from the audit §2.4 definition (interestPaid + miCost + financedFee, principal excluded) and the post-cancellation payment from the documented per-program MI cancellation rule. Both matched the application on every field with zero discrepancies, so they are no longer merely change-detected.
